query: What review signals predict low Yelp user satisfaction?

per_column.name: neg_word_count
per_column.rationale: Count of negative lexicon words derived from text; lies outside the label and plausibly correlates with low satisfaction.

per_column.name: pos_word_count
per_column.rationale: Count of positive lexicon words; a legitimate text-derived signal predicting positive sentiment label.

per_column.name: sentiment_score
per_column.rationale: Continuous lexicon-based sentiment; a plausible predictor of label_pos, not a deterministic restatement of it.

per_column.name: negation_adjusted_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Sentiment refined for negation handling; a distinct, plausibly stronger predictive feature of the label.

per_column.name: complaint_phrase_count
per_column.rationale: Counts explicit complaint phrases in text; carries targeted signal about low satisfaction while remaining outside the label.

per_column.name: exclamation_ratio
per_column.rationale: Stylistic intensity feature; weak but legitimate predictor, not a component of the label.

per_column.name: caps_ratio
per_column.rationale: Proportion of capitalized characters; stylistic emphasis signal, plausibly mildly predictive, not leakage.

per_column.name: review_length_tokens
per_column.rationale: Length is a generic but legitimate covariate that can correlate with satisfaction; weak predictor.

per_column.name: predicted_low_satisfaction
per_column.rationale: A prediction of the outcome itself; it is a direct proxy/restatement of the focus label and constitutes target leakage.

judge.rationale: Most columns are genuine text-derived features (sentiment, negation-adjusted sentiment, complaint counts, positive/negative word counts) that plausibly predict label_pos without restating it, giving real predictive leverage. Several stylistic features (exclamation ratio, caps ratio, length) are weaker and somewhat generic. However 'predicted_low_satisfaction' is target leakage—a direct proxy of the focus—and should be excluded. As a set, the sentiment and complaint features provide solid, non-trivial signal beyond the raw text, warranting a moderately high but not maximal utility.
